shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them, hosts HugsLib's and Archotech Logs' log-window buttons in a suite-styled add-on tray, and can throttle runaway log spam. Plus a knowledge-base browser, in-game bug/fix reporting, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, impact scoring, content-fingerprint mod-change detection, and a public v2 API for other mods.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Version constant `1.3`; v1.2 is live on the Workshop.**

### Governing rule: everything shown is a factual claim
This mod tells players which mod broke their game and whether a mod changed. People act on it.
- **Fail closed.** When evidence is incomplete, say nothing and say *why*.
- **A match string must be provably reachable from `Log`** — and "emitted by identified code", NOT "present in Assembly-CSharp". A ubiquitous framework mod counts as an emitter (see XML Extensions below).
- **Never re-derive an identity you already held.** Record the name/id when you observe it.
- **Never rank ourselves as culprit for an error we only reported.**

---

## Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`, gated on `LogWindowCompat.ModernOwnsLog`. List (culled) + inspector + add-on tray. Toolbar B is a right-to-left cursor: Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, **Vanilla log** (only when a decorator is detected), search. Compat hint strip **frame-latched** (`_hintFrame`). Repeat chip shows `x{repeats}+{suppressed}`.

### Log-window ownership + interop
- **HugsLib** — `LogWindowExtensions.AddLogWindowWidget` is the community hook. `LogWidgets` reflects its private `widgets` list and rebinds each `Drawer` via `Delegate.CreateDelegate` (not `DynamicInvoke`). Tray-hosted; throwing widgets dropped. `LogWidgets.Any` frame-latched (the tray sizes the body rect).
- **Archotech Logs** — `ArchotechBridge` hosts Diagnostics/Export. `Dialog_ArchotechInfoView(EditWindow_Log)` uses the host only for positioning and both consumers null-check it → **passing null is supported**. Its `DoWindowContents` reads the private **static** `EditWindow_Log.selectedMessage`, so `LogState.Selected` raises `SelectionChanged` and `ArchotechBridge` mirrors into that static.
- `yieldLogWindow` = full stand-down. Tray restyle: on-demand prefix on the 7-arg `Widgets.ButtonText` funnel, gated on `LogWidgets.Drawing`, control-count safe, honours `drawBackground:false`, fails open.

### `LogThrottle` — optional suppression of repeating lines (default OFF)
`Log.Error/Warning/Message` evaluate `StackTraceUtility.ExtractStackTrace()` as an ARGUMENT, before `Enqueue` sees a repeat; below the cap of 99 every occurrence does a synchronous disk write; all inside `lock(logLock)`. **`LogMessageQueue` only combines with `lastMessage`** → dedupe is strictly consecutive; interleaved spam (A,B,A,B) never combines. Allocation-free FNV-1a + 64-slot ring; first `Threshold`(5) pass; 10s quiet window resets; `Environment.TickCount` (Log.Error can be off-thread); own short lock; fails open, latches off. Summaries drained from the `Root.Update` hook, never the prefix. Suppressed counts surface in the chip and fold into `ImpactAssessor.EffectiveRepeats`.

---

## Attribution pipeline
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`. 13 modules in `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`. `RankedMods()` cached, invalidated by `Merge`.

**`LogAnalysis` fills `Frames` from `LogMessage.StackTrace`** — for a `Log.Error(text)` call that is the stack of the CALLER, not of whatever threw. This is why self-report suppression is necessary (below).

- `Module_StackTrace` — frames → owning assembly; falls back to `NamespaceRoot` (only when exactly ONE loaded mod declares that root; `FrameworkRoots` blocks IL-merged `System.*`/`Newtonsoft.*` claims). **Skips self-attribution when the message starts with `ModernDevToolsMod.LogPrefix`.**
- `Module_LogPrefix` — `[ModName]` tags via `MatchTag` (unambiguous + ACTIVE only). **Strips Unity rich-text markup first.**
- `Module_MessageMentions` — the three vanilla `Mod X …` grammars (GREEDY captures), packageId tokens, mod folders in paths.
- `Module_HarmonyPatches` — reverse index of patched methods → owner ids; conflict claim needs ≥2 foreign patchers or a Harmony-routed trace.
- `Module_DependencyCheck`, `Module_AboutIncompat`, `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`, `Module_Community`, `Module_Glossary`, `Module_CircinusCorpus`, `Module_ReflectionBridge`.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > KnownIssues n−i (benign +1000). Context-only modules must score **< 1**.

### `IssueScoring` — ONE matcher for four knowledge surfaces
Weights (ExceptionType 3 / Regex 3 / Keyword 2 / Namespace 2 / PackageId 2) shared by the shipped library, mod-shipped files, API sources and the community DB. Allocation-free `OrdinalIgnoreCase` `IndexOf`. `RegexOptions.Compiled` deliberately dropped in the shared compiler (Mono Reflection.Emit, never reclaimed); FrameParser keeps it.

---

## Correctness audit — 2026-11, four passes + live validation (run #232)

### 1. Mod-change detection — REWRITTEN (`ModFingerprint` + `ModChange`)
**Reported bug:** a mod last updated in January flagged **updated**. Root cause: the token was `Directory.GetLastWriteTimeUtc(RootDir).Ticks` — not a content measure in either direction. A directory's write time changes when a *direct child entry* is created/deleted/renamed (Steam re-downloading identical bytes, verify-integrity, library moves, copies, restores) and does **not** change when a file deep inside is edited. Steam stamps the **local download time**, never the publish date.

Four further defects in the same 90 lines: `token = ""` on stat failure then compared to a real value (failed *open* into a false claim); `NameOf()` re-derived names via `GetModWithIdentifier(pid, ignorePostfix:true)`, which is keyed on the **stripped** id (any `_steam` id → null) and otherwise returns `ElementAtOrDefault(0)` = the **local** copy; `d[pid] = token` last-writer-wins with `_steam` making `PackageId` itself unstable; comparer lost across Scribe.

**Now:** FNV-1a 64 over the sorted list of (relative path, file **length**) for every file under the mod's roots. **No timestamps**, so re-downloads/copies/restores/library moves reproduce the same hash. Low-priority background thread from `Bootstrap`; depth-capped at 24 (mod folders are often symlinks); excludes `.git/.svn/.hg/.vs/.idea/obj/bin/node_modules`; 40k files/mod. Unreadable dir or over budget ⇒ **UNKNOWN, never a guess**. Official Ludeon content is presence-tracked only.
- Keys `_steam`-normalized; local+Steam copies hashed **together** (moving between `Mods/` and Workshop is not a change).
- The display **name is recorded in the save** from the loaded `ModContentPack`.
- Versioned (`mdtSnapshotVersion` + `mdtModSnapshotV2`).
- **Updated** requires BOTH fingerprints known and different; otherwise `Unverified`, shown as a footer.
- Deferred completion via `ModChange.TickPending()` on the permanent `Root.Update` postfix.
- **Legacy fallback (added after run #232):** the pre-1.3 `mdtModSnapshot` node is read on LOAD ONLY (guarded so it is never written back). Its ticks are discarded but its KEYS are valid packageIds, so added/removed still works — `PresenceOnly` mode, structurally incapable of claiming "updated". Motivated by run #232: a save whose mods had genuinely been removed (RimVali FFA, WorkShift, Faction Colonies) produced a wall of cross-reference errors while this panel stayed silent. Names for removed mods resolve via the EXACT `GetModWithIdentifier(pid)`, falling back to the raw packageId — honest rather than a guess.
- Setting `detectModChanges` (default on), General card.
- **Accepted limit:** an edit preserving every file's exact byte length is invisible. Deliberate.

### 2. Self-attribution — FIXED (found live, run #232)
A Harmony **finalizer always appears in the trace of the exception it reports**. Vehicle Framework's `SmashTools.DetachedMapComponentCache` threw `KeyNotFoundException` in the colonist bar; `HardeningPatches.MapBefore_Finalizer` caught and reported it. Because `Frames` comes from the *caller's* stack, the ONLY frames present were ours → attributed at `WeightStackBase` (5), and since Vehicle Framework was found only via a file path (frameIndex −1, FirstIndex `int.MaxValue`) the tie broke on FirstIndex and **we ranked first** — the tool blaming itself for the bug it just caught. Fix: `Module_StackTrace` skips self when `ctx.Text` starts with `ModernDevToolsMod.LogPrefix` (`"[Modern Dev Tools]"`). A genuine unhandled exception in our code is logged by the ENGINE without that prefix and still attributes normally. **Every internal `Log.*` call must keep that prefix.**

### 3. Third-party knowledge files could claim another mod's error — FIXED
`Module_ModIssues` scored every `About/known-issues.json` entry against every error at the **highest score in the scale** (9+) with `FromLibrary=true`. One mod shipping `"keywords": ["NullReferenceException"]` would take the top slot for every unrelated error. `RemoteIssue` now carries `OwnerPackageId` + `HasExplicitScope`; a shipped entry applies only when the error implicates its owner, or it names its own packageIds/namespaces. API-registered sources exempt (deliberate code-level act).

### 4. Wrong-copy attribution in `InstalledModIndex` — FIXED
`ByName`/`ByFolder`/`ByPackageId` were first-writer-wins, so a stale **inactive** local copy could win a key — and `Module_VersionMismatch` then reads **its** About.xml, producing a false "does not support 1.6". `Put()` prefers the ACTIVE mod.

### 5. Lazy regex truncated mod names — FIXED
The three vanilla `^Mod (.+?) …` grammars stopped at the FIRST literal occurrence, yielding a truncated name matching no installed mod, shown as a culprit that does not exist. Now greedy `(.+)` with the trailing literal anchored (4 sites).

### 6. Phantom match strings — and the rule that was too narrow
The 2026-08 audit verified strings **exist in Core**; the test that matters is **reachable from `Log`**. Two classes fail it:
- **`GetModWarnings()` output** (`ModsConfig.cs:513`) is consumed only by `Page_ModsConfig.cs:337` for the mod-list tooltip. **`MDT_Incompatible` removed** (all 5 keywords) — its broadest, "incompatible with", matched any mod's prose and was presented as curated knowledge. Same info is produced proactively by `Module_DependencyCheck` + `Module_AboutIncompat`.
- **`loadErrors` lists** surface only in the translation report; the log gets a COUNT (`LoadedLanguage.cs:566`). `"tried to translate field"` → `"generate translation report for more info"` (confirmed live).
Also removed as non-existent: `"found no type named"`.

**`Module_DependencyCheck.MissingRefSignals` had never been audited** (the pass covered `Defs/`, not C# lists). 3 of 8 were phantoms, incl. `"could not find def named"` — standing in for RimWorld's most common cascade; the real string is `"Failed to find <Type> named X. There are N defs of this type loaded."` (`DefDatabase.cs:217`). OR-gate ⇒ silent false negatives. Rebuilt against verified call sites. **Confirmed live** by `Failed to find RimWorld.HairDef named Frozen. There are 480 defs of this type loaded.`

**CORRECTION — the rule over-fired once.** `"failed to find a node"` and `"xpath"` were removed for not existing in Assembly-CSharp. Correct about vanilla, wrong about reality: **XML Extensions** (`imranfish.xmlextensions`, load order #18) installs a `Finalizer` on ApplyWorker of all five vanilla pathed operations (`Source.HarmonyPatches.PatchOperationPathed_DefaultPatches`) emitting `{Type}(xpath="{xpath}"): Failed to find a node with the given xpath`. It intercepts patch failures for the WHOLE modlist, so in practice it, not vanilla, is what players see. **Both restored** with decompiled provenance. Lesson: the emitter may be a ubiquitous framework mod; the entry still must never name a third-party mod to the player.

### 7. Coverage gaps closed from live output (run #232)
- `MDT_UnknownType` — added `"could not find a type named"` (`ParseHelper.cs:227`, note the "a"; a separate grammar).
- `MDT_DuplicateDef` — added `"has multiple"` (`DefDatabase.cs:33`).
- `MDT_MissingTexture` — added `"collection cannot init"` (`Graphic_Collection.cs:47`) and `"failed to find any textures at"` (`Graphic_Multi.cs:108`). Only the *least* common `ContentFinder` form was covered.
- `MDT_LoadReference` — added `"null key while loading dictionary"` (`Scribe_Collections.cs:404`); seen twice from unrelated mods, each time immediately after a `Could not load reference to` line for the same def type — it is the downstream symptom, same cause and fix.
- `Module_LogPrefix` — strips Unity rich text (`<color=…>[MeleeAnim]</color>`, `[Map Mode Framework]`) so the leading-tag test isn't defeated.

Defs: `KnownIssueDefs.xml` 42, `BenignLogDefs.xml` 5, `ErrorModules.xml` 13, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` 17.

### Known-remaining, NOT fixed
- **Lunar Framework side-loading blindspot.** Map Preview / Geological Landforms ship only `LunarLoader.dll` in `Assemblies/`; real code lives in `Lunar/Components/` and is side-loaded. It is absent from `ModContentPack.assemblies.loadedAssemblies`, so BOTH `ByAssembly` and `BuildNamespaceRoots` miss it and stack attribution goes blind — only the `[Map Preview v1.12.25]` log tag identifies it. Fails **silent, not wrong**. A location-based fix (map `Assembly.Location` into the owning `RootDir`) must use a REDUCED weight and its own reason string: both mods ship the same `MapPreview.dll`, so location-mapping could name Geological Landforms for a Map Preview bug, and at `WeightStackBase` it would outrank the correct log-prefix answer.
- `Module_Community` uses `ModsConfig.IsActive(pid)` with community ids that never carry `_steam` → silently misses postfixed mods. False negative only.
- Engine dicts use `CurrentCultureIgnoreCase` + culture-sensitive `ToLower()`; we use `OrdinalIgnoreCase`. Turkish-locale divergence possible. **Unverified.**
- Two ACTIVE mods sharing a display name remain a coin flip in `ExactName`.
- `ModDependencyIndex` parity with `ModsConfig.FindConflicts` **unverified**.
- Uncovered grammars seen live: `Parsed 1.5 as int.`, `[SafePatcher]The xPath: … not found`, texture/mask dimension mismatch, `has no resolvedGrains`.

### MissileGirl / RocketMan-fork compatibility — investigated, CLEAR
`vr.missilegirl` ("Missile Girl - Performance Mod") is a RocketMan fork (Gagarin / Soyuz / Proton / Cosmodrome).
- Its `Extras/RocketRules_Incompatibilities.xml` lists only Multiplayer and RimThreaded — **we are not declared incompatible**.
- **Gagarin caches to `LocalLow/.../DefLoadCache` and `LocalLow/MissileGirl`, NOT into mod folders** — the critical question for `ModFingerprint`, since a cache written inside a mod folder would flip its fingerprint every run and reproduce the original false-positive bug at scale. Verified clear.
- `Gagarin.AssetHashingUtility.CalculateHash` hashes **asset CONTENT** (sampling every other char, `lowTolerance`), so our Defs edits DO invalidate its cache — def changes are testable with it active.
- Empirical: **zero** files written inside local mod folders during a full session (workshop scan timed out, unverified there).
- Only log line all run: `GAGARIN: Cache created! …` (informational).

---

## Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` banned except the dev palette's category line. Icons via `MdtTex`. Helpers: `SearchField`, `ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`/`DrawWell`/`DrawPlate`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `DrawCheck`, `ModuleRow`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`/`ResetGuiState`.
- Never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window`. Size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.
- **`DrawPlate`** gated to `Prefs.UIScale == 1f` where `AdjustRectToUIScaling` reduces to floor/ceil. *Unverified at 125/150%.*
- **`BeginScroll` is re-entrant** (skin styles on a STACK — `ErrorModule.DrawSection` runs inside the inspector's live scroll view). All scroll sites in try/finally; `ResetGuiState()` unwinds strays.

### `TextMetrics`
Memoised `CalcHeight`/`CalcSize` keyed on (text, rounded width, resolved GameFont, fontSize, WordWrap). `Text.Font`'s getter returns the *coerced* font (Tiny→Small when `TinyFontSupported` is false). Cap-then-clear at 8192. Main thread only.

## Tool 4: knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited. **Viewport-culled** — `BeginScrollView` clips pixels but doesn't skip draw code, so cards measure (memoised) but skip drawing outside a **frame-latched** window. Def counts cached. Glossary ~26 terms, `AllTerms()` cached.

## Tools 2/3: dev actions + palette
`Window_ModernDevActions` (3-tab, vanilla node graph, icon-grid spawn pickers, BFS search). `Window_ModernDevPalette` — resolved nodes cached against a hash of `Prefs.DebugActionsPalette`; pin/reorder sets `_pendingResizeFrame` applied a LATER frame (changing row count mid-frame shifts IMGUI ids).

## Hardening + `HardeningPatches`
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, off by default. All 7 hardening patches, 3 throttle prefixes and the tray restyle install only while their feature is on. **One permanent patch: postfix on `Verse.Root.Update`** driving `SyncIfNeeded()` + `LogThrottle.DrainSummaries()` + `ModChange.TickPending()`. Apply MUST happen there, never from the settings UI (which runs *inside* two targets). Failures latch `_broken`. **Confirmed working live** in run #232 (caught Vehicle Framework's UI exception and kept the map interface alive).

## Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json. `LogAnalysisCache.Clear()` raises a volatile `_dirty` flag; swap on next main-thread read.

## Public API v2 (`ModernDevToolsAPI`) — frozen contract
`ApiVersion = 2`. v1: `RegisterModule`, `Invalidate`. v2: `RegisterKnowledgeSource`, `RegisterLogWidget`, `AnalysisCompleted`, `ModernOwnsLogWindow`, `IsModernLogOpen`, `OpenModernLog()`, `YieldLogWindow()`. Reflection-bindable; `LogWidgetDrawer` signature-identical to HugsLib's `WidgetDrawer`. **TODO:** document the `About/known-issues.json` scoping change (audit item 3) in `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md` — no signature changed, but real-world behaviour narrowed.

## Settings surfaces — parity contract
`SettingsPage.Draw` canonical superset; `Dialog_Modules` quick subset. Cards: Log window, Log spam, General (incl. `detectModChanges`), Modules, Ignored, Community, Experimental hardening. `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

## Testing / environment notes
- Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.
- Run #232 was on the user's real ~910-mod list. ~75 error classes captured; **exactly one** was attributed to us, and that was hardening *reporting* Vehicle Framework's exception (which produced fix #2).
- That run's save load failed upstream: `ScribeLoader.FinalizeLoading()` → `CrossRefHandler.ResolveAllCrossReferences()` → FactionControl postfix → **Worldbuilder `Faction_Name_Patch.Postfix` NRE**, because factions were null after mods were removed. All later errors were cascade; the session became unrecoverable.

## State: 1.3 built; audit + live fixes applied; mod-change panel STILL UNVERIFIED
Builds clean, XML validates.
**Unverified:** (a) the mod-change panel has never actually been observed — run #232's save never finished loading; (b) `ModFingerprint` scan cost/completion on ~910 mods (unmeasured); (c) v2 snapshot Scribe round-trip; (d) `PresenceOnly` legacy path; (e) self-report suppression; (f) mod-shipped-issue scoping; (g) tray restyle; (h) Archotech tray buttons + selection mirroring; (i) throttle actually suppressing; (j) nothing profiled; (k) 2-draw card at 125/150%.
**Next test must be:** restart RimWorld fully → load a *working* save (or new colony) → save → reload → panel must report ZERO changes.

## Release / publishing
v1.2 live: Workshop 3771602203, git `98f6ca6` on `Astryls/ModernDevTools`. 1.3 prepped: version bumped, `MDT_UpdateNotesBody` rewritten with an "Accuracy fixes" section, About.xml + docs updated.
**Community DB synced:** `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/main/known-issues.json` regenerated from the audited `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` (17 entries). **User action: push that folder to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`** or the opt-in fetch keeps overwriting good local data with bad.

## GitHub Backup
MIT. Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked.
